ingredients.name: pre-made pizza crust, rolled out to 12 inches across
green bell pepper, seeded and thinly sliced

steps.instruction: Brush the pizza crust with 2 tablespoons of olive oil.
Ladle 9 tablespoons of tomato sauce over the crust and spread it evenly.
Spread 9 ounces of grated mozzarella cheese evenly over the sauce.
Spread 4 ounces of grated parmesan cheese evenly over the crust.
Lay 1/2 sliced green bell pepper and 1/2 diced Roma tomato over the cheese.
Add 1/2 cup of spinach, 1/2 cup of sliced mushrooms and 1/2 cup of sliced onion.
Add 9 fresh basil leaves and 4 1/2 tablespoons of sliced black olives.
Press the toppings down with a utensil if they stand too high.
steps.spoken: If needed, press the toppings down with a utensil so they clear the top of the oven. You can also top the vegetables with extra cheese and sauce to hold them down.

steps.instruction: Bake the pizza for 15 minutes, until the crust edges are deep dark brown.
steps.spoken: Bake the pizza until the crust edges are deep dark brown. That takes roughly 15 minutes for a pre-made crust, and much longer for fresh dough.

steps.instruction: Take the pizza out of the oven and let it cool.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
